info.title: i10 API
info.description: Transactional email. The document is generated from the same Zod schemas the server validates with and the SDKs are built from, so it cannot drift from the implementation.

bearerAuth.description: Your i10 API key. Keys are prefixed `i10_live_` or `i10_test_` so they are recognisable in your own logs and greppable in a leak scan.

sessionAuth.name: __session
sessionAuth.description: The Clerk session cookie set when you sign in at auth.i10.tech. Used by the console for mailbox management; it is not an alternative to an API key, and the sending endpoints do not accept it.

post.description: Queues a single message and returns its id immediately. The id is minted in the same transaction as the caller's own work, so a rollback never sends.

404.description: The `template` named does not exist, or has no such version.

409.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

post.description: Registers an https URL to receive events. The signing secret is returned here and never again - store it before you discard the response.

200.description: Created. `secret` is shown only in this response.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

422.description: The URL or the event list is not acceptable.

200.description: Every endpoint for this tenant. Secrets are never included.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

delete.description: Deletes the endpoint and every delivery recorded against it. Pending deliveries stop; already-sent ones are not recalled.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

404.description: No such endpoint for this API key's tenant.

post.description: Issues a new signing key and returns its secret once. You choose what happens to the key it replaces: `previous_secret: "revoke"` stops it immediately; `previous_secret: "expire"` with `expires_in` (60 to 259200 seconds, which is 72 hours) keeps it signing alongside the new one so you can deploy the new secret first. While both are live, every webhook carries one signature per key. At most 3 keys are live at once. Pass `signature_scheme` to switch between HMAC and Ed25519.

200.description: Rotated. `secret` is shown only in this response (null for Ed25519, which you verify with `public_key`).

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

404.description: No such endpoint for this API key's tenant.

422.description: No choice for the previous secret, an `expires_in` out of range, or too many live keys.

post.description: Ends every grace period chosen at rotation, now. From this request on, only the current key signs. Use it when a previous secret may have leaked.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

404.description: No such endpoint for this API key's tenant.

get.description: Newest first. Addresses here are skipped at send, whichever domain the message is from.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

post.description: Idempotent: suppressing an address that already is changes nothing.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

delete.description: Mail to the address is sent again. If it bounces or complains again it is suppressed again automatically. ⚠ An address suppressed for a complaint needs `confirm=complaint`: its recipient marked your mail as spam.

200.description: Removed, here and at our sending provider.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

503.description: Our sending provider could not be updated; nothing changed.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

post.description: Send the body exactly as you will send it, with `{{name}}` wherever a value goes. Once our team approves it, messages matching it exactly stop counting as repeated content. Approval never excuses bounces or spam complaints, and is withdrawn automatically when they run high. Links inside values must point at your own verified domains.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

409.description: The same template is already waiting for review or approved.

422.description: The template is not acceptable, or the workspace is at its limit.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

delete.description: Takes back a submission waiting for review, or an approval. Mail matching it is then treated like any other mail. The record stays, marked `withdrawn`.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The key is restricted to a domain.

404.description: No pending or approved submission with that id.

post.description: Claims a domain for sending and returns the DNS records to publish. The domain is unusable until those records exist and `POST /domains/{id}/verify` has confirmed them.

201.description: Created, with the records to publish.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

403.description: The plan does not include another domain.

422.description: The name is not a domain.

get.description: Summaries only. Fetch one domain to see its DNS records.

200.description: Every domain this key's tenant owns, newest first.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

200.description: The domain, with the records to publish.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

patch.description: Turns open and click tracking on or off for mail sent from this domain. Both are off by default. Opens are recorded with a tracking pixel and clicks by rewriting links through a redirect, so turn them on only where you have a lawful basis to track your recipients. The change applies to the next message sent, including ones already accepted but not yet sent.

200.description: The domain, with the new settings.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

422.description: Nothing to update, or a field is not a boolean.

delete.description: Removes the domain and its sending identity. Mail already accepted is unaffected; nothing new can be sent from it afterwards.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

post.description: Asks the provider to re-check the DNS records. Verification is not instant: a `pending` answer means the records have not propagated yet, and `temporary_failure` means the lookup itself failed and is worth retrying - neither means the records are wrong.

200.description: The domain as it now stands.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or unknown.

409.description: Another workspace verified this domain first. A name may be held by any number of workspaces while it is pending, but only by one once ownership has been proved.

post.description: Creates a mailbox for the signed-in user on a domain i10 hosts mail for. The account must have a password: mail clients sign in with it, so an account created through Google or an email link cannot hold a mailbox until one is set.

201.description: Created. The mailbox can receive mail and be signed in to.

401.description: Not signed in.

403.description: The plan does not include another mailbox.

409.description: The account has no password, the address is taken, or the user already has a mailbox.

422.description: The address is not one we can host.

503.description: The session could not be verified.

200.description: The signed-in user's mailboxes. Empty if they have none.

401.description: Not signed in.

503.description: The session could not be verified.
